summary: Reviewed WI-763 on branch `harden-pr-semantic-review-gate` at HEAD `a547ff0d05d6929d718490a389634056374267d8` (worktree clean; only untracked runtime review output present). The PR-specific gate mechanism is semantically correct: `.github/workflows/pr-merge-gate.yml` checks out the PR head SHA and runs `pr-gate check`; `pr-gate` fails closed on missing/stale/non-allow authored review approval and explicitly prevents raw/shadow/runtime evidence from satisfying approval; `controlled-merge check|merge` verifies host required-check enforcement (branch protection and/or ruleset readback) before delegating to host merge. Remaining work is evidence/host configuration and recording this formal review into the single authored review record consumed by the gate.

findings.summary: Host enforcement for `loom-pr-merge-gate` is not yet proven by live GitHub readback (required check via branch protection or active ruleset, plus a real PR-head run); repo-local workflow presence and local validation are not sufficient to claim “host-enforced” closure for the PR #762 regression class.

disposition.summary: Collect and record fresh host readback evidence that `loom-pr-merge-gate` is required on `main` (branch protection and/or ruleset) and that the check ran for the target PR head SHA.

findings.details: category: unresolved; boundary: requires host state readback outside the repo tree.

findings.summary: The authored review record `.loom/reviews/WI-763.json` is still a scaffold (`decision: fallback`, placeholder reviewer/validation summary). Until it is replaced by this concluded formal review (and bound to the reviewed head + validation summary), `checkpoint merge` / `pr-gate` will fail closed and cannot prove PR-local approval.

disposition.summary: Backwrite this formal review into `.loom/reviews/WI-763.json` with a concluded decision, correct reviewer identity, and freshness bindings (`reviewed_head`, `reviewed_validation_summary`, and head-binding contract).

findings.details: category: unresolved; impact: gate cannot pass until the single authored review record is real and fresh.

findings.summary: The required check workflow checks out and executes repository code from the PR head (`python3 tools/loom_flow.py ...`). This is acceptable for trusted contributor sets, but it is a security/trust boundary decision if untrusted external PRs can trigger the required check.

disposition.summary: Document and enforce contributor trust assumptions before making `loom-pr-merge-gate` required (or redesign the workflow to avoid executing arbitrary PR-head code via pinned tooling / API-fetched artifacts).

findings.details: category: new; boundary: host-required check executes PR-supplied code with a read-scoped token.
